title: Observation never reverses authority
summary: Instrumentation Mesh carries and retains operational facts but does not become the authority that created them. The producer owns service/fabric truth, Queue Fabric/XTP owns transport and peer authentication, and Keynote/Wire3D owns presentation only.
invariants: Stable semantic identity is separate from endpoint, IP address, route, region and 3D position.
No sample is not zero; stale evidence is not fabricated failure.
Source health and observation freshness are distinct facts: HEALTHY+STALE is valid.
Metrics, relationships and events are evidence. They do not grant mutation authority.
A management command must pass authenticated peer identity, Instrumentation authorization and the target service's own authority checks.
Keynote rendering or selection never grants management authority.
Instrumentation Intentions and Management Intention Discovery remain read-side discovery surfaces.
